segments.text: A mad scientist in the employ of the Black Lodge syndicate. Arkham City is plagued by disturbances created when his bizarre inventions run amok, and the destruction created by his robotic minions is the drumbeat of anarchy by which Arkham now sets its clocks.

His aesthetic sense is incomprehensibly alien to others, and notions of good and evil are sacrificed in pursuit of the boundaries of his whimsy. Put simply: he's the comic relief. However, his inventions are not to be taken lightly.
From the Official Site - Nitroplus USA

Taking center stage in the heroine department and their school's drama club, Miyuki's role within our tale is that of Shin'ichi's childhood friend – although no one else thankfully knows that. Having played together a lot when they were younger, they grew apart as they got older. Our hero has to watch someone he once shared a strong bond become a school idol, having many (including girls and teachers) confess to her. In the barren wasteland that is their school, she’s a lone flower which managed to bloom.

Among Miyuki's vast array of talents, batting is one of them. She's rarely seen without her bat, and can often be found at the town's local batting center practicing her swings. Unsurprisingly, wherever Miyuki goes her bat isn’t too far from her. Although, there are suspect rumors involving it...

She's not the idol everyone and her mother makes her out to be. As Miyuki is someone who’s accustomed to acting and hiding their true face, Shin'ichi is the only one who can see right through it. She can get miffed all too easily behind closed doors, and is something of a tsundere.
Taken from Goldensneer's review

Given that she’s a character who focuses on getting in contact with god through her chants of "touarururururu~"s, it's no wonder that Aoi is someone whose presence isn't noticed by others – or rather, ignored. A classmate of Shin'ichi and Miyuki's, her brain is full of nothing but games. Going beyond casual jokes and spouting dated memes like other visual novel savvy characters, there's something inherently destructive about the way our mysterious little denpa darling has to liken everything in their lives to a visual novel. Shin'ichi and Miyuki have a stunted conversation? That's a flag. A friendship defining moment happens? You better save to relive the memory later, because the OP is probably going to play any minute now.

Poor at socializing, both Shin'ichi and Miyuki feel like she's unable to draw a line between reality and visual novels, having them seamlessly merge. While she may seem like a poorly written denpa character coming off as deliberately unhinged from the outset, the reader can't help but wonder if there's more to her than meets her clouded eyes.
Taken from Goldensneer's review

segments.text: The hero of our story, Daijuuji Kurou is down on his luck. Unable to handle the pressures of life at Miskatonic University, he dropped out to start his own private detective business; life as an investigator treats him little better than his student days however, and he's forced to rely on the local orphanage for support between his infrequent cases.
From the Official Site - Nitroplus USA
本作の主人公。繁盛しない探偵業で食うや食わずの生活を送る青年。
アルに気に入られたせいで想像を絶する戦いの渦中に投げ込まれる。
実は魔術の素養も持っているのだが、本人は訳あって魔術そのものを忌避している。
天才的な魔術の才能を秘めた私立探偵
マスター・オブ・ネクロノミコン

探偵・大十字九郎は、魔術学の最高峰・ミスカトニック大学の陰秘学科に在席していたという、異例の過去を持つ。端正な顔立ちのわりに2枚目半だが、弱者を虐げる悪には激しい怒りを覚え、それを見過ごすことができないという熱血漢でもある。ここ最近は探偵業の依頼がなく、いつ行き倒れてもおかしくない超極貧生活を送っていた。また、ある資産家が「九郎を陰秘学科に」と名ざしで指名し、資金面での援助を受けるなど、不思議な経緯でミスカトニック大学に入学している。大学在学中、九郎はメキメキと才能を開花させて学科の主席にまで登りつめるが、最高位の魔導書の閲覧を許された日に突然、大学を辞めてしまう。友人ライカにもその理由を語ろうとしないが、その日以来、九郎が魔術を忌避するようになったのは確かである。

Known by many names and forms through the centuries, Al Azif's girlish appearance is deceptive: she is the avatar of a grimoire, and not just any tome of spells. She embodies the original Necronomicon itself, an icon of forbidden magic eagerly pursued by ambitious sorcerers eager to amplify their powers.

In the modern age, Al has developed a mind of her own. Fiercely independent and outspoken, she is fearless in thought and deed, but knows when to run away from those who would use her for unpleasant ends... unless her escape is blocked by a certain bumbling detective.
From the Official Site - Nitroplus USA
ひょんなことから九郎のパートナーになる謎の少女。

その力を利用しようとする魔術結社ブラックロッジに追われていた最中、
九郎と出会う。九郎の潜在的な魔力を見抜き、彼を主(あるじ)とする契約を結び、ブラックロッジとの戦闘へと誘う。
可憐な容姿とは裏腹に性格は尊大かつ傲岸不遜。
そんなギャップが事あるごとにトラブルの種になる。

九郎の口喧嘩相手にして、史上最強のパートナー

狂気の詩人アブドウル・アルハザードがこの世に残した稀代の魔導書『アル・アジフ』。その書物に宿る精霊が彼女、アル・アジフである。外見は幼くかわいらしいか、すでに1000年もの時を生きている。口が悪く、倣岸不遜、尊大な性格の持ち主で、本来ならば敬意を払うべきである主、九郎にもまるで容赦がない。アル・アジフは世界最強の魔導書のうちの1冊とされ、その記述の1部を別の言語に訳した写本『死霊秘法(ネクロノミコン)』も有名である。アル・アジフを手に入れた者は、その内に記述された魔術、モンスター、アーティファクトの使役はもちろん、神の模造品ことデウス・マキナをも招喚することができるという。だが、現在のアルはページの多くを失った不完全体で、写本並みの力しか出せないでいる。失われたページのなかには、"外なる神"に関する禁忌の記述もあったというが……。このアルのように意思を持った魔導書は、術者に従うものの、自身の目的のために術者の意識を操り、ときとして主を犠牲にしても保身を優先することがある。こうした性質は魔術師側にも充分に認知されているところであり、術者も魔導書も、たがいを利用する打算関係を築くのが普通とされる。だが、九郎はそうせず、アルを友のように扱う。アルはそんな九郎を素人扱いするが、やがて、そうした奇妙な関係を自然に受け入れている自分に気がつくこととなる。そもそも九郎とアル、そしてデモンべインの出逢いは、運命ならぬ宿命にほかならなかった。その理由は、狂気に陥りながらもアル・アジフを残したアルハザードの真意とともに明らかになっていく。

A new Taimanin introduced in Taimanin Asagi 3 and also the second protagonist. She was Asagi's prodigy two years before the event of the third game, and her body had been damaged in battle around that time leaving her limbless. She then mysteriously disappeared after that incident. She shows up two years later in the third game having replaced her limbs with robotic arms and legs making her even more powerful than before.

Kurisu is a neuroscience researcher at an American university, and can speak and read English well. Having had her research published in the academic journal Science at the young age of 18, Makise is extremely talented. She skipped a grade in the American school system. She does not get along with her father and has not spoken to him in many years. Okabe often just calls her assistant or one of a number of nicknames he comes up with, such as "Christina", "the Zombie", and "Celeb Sev", none of which she likes. She is considered a tsundere character; she dislikes this characterization as well, strongly objecting whenever Daru mentions it.

Mayuri is a long-time childhood friend of Okabe and a bit of an airhead. Mayuri enjoys creating cosplay costumes and has a part-time job at a maid cafe called "Mayqueen Nyannyan". She often calls herself Mayushii, a portmanteau of her given name and surname, which is also what Daru calls her. She has a distinctive sing-song way of speaking, and she typically sings "tutturuu" when she arrives or introduces herself.

Rintarou is an eccentric individual, a self-proclaimed mad scientist and often refers to himself under the alias of Hououin Kyouma, which is also the name he uses to introduce himself to other people. Mayuri and Daru refer to him by the nickname Okarin, a portmanteau of his surname and given name. He is the founder of what he calls the "Future Gadget Laboratory" in Akihabara where he spends most of his time. Rintarou gives off the appearance of being delusional and paranoid, frequently referring to the "organization" that is after him, talking to himself on his phone, and engaging in fits of maniacal laughter. Most of the time he takes on a fairly arrogant personality. He is usually seen wearing a lab coat.
As he experiments with time travel, he learns that he is the only one who possesses the ability to determine changes between different timelines, which he dubs "Reading Steiner".
The character is 18 years old and a first year student at Tokyo Denki University.
